comments.author: RyzenLLC
comments.body_html:
My mod is simpler because it eliminates the additional features of another mod, also solves the problem with “immortal” Scavs/PMCs, and is implemented a little differently.

My mod does not restore the head and chest, but prevents them from being completely destroyed, leaving at least 1 HP there and there respectively.

comments.author: Devraccoon Senior Moderator
comments.body_html:
I looked at the implementation myself, and I can’t really see how it’s implemented differently? from what I can see, and read, it’s more or less the same mod as Demi with less features. immortality from AI was solved a long time ago, and all my features are toggleable as I understand people want modularity. :)

I should add that it’s an open community. you do what you want, and you should make stuff you like. just please don’t try to claim that you’re solving a problem that doesn’t exist. Demi no longer has immortal AI, and it will allow you to have just 1HP mode without any other fluff.

comments.author: RyzenLLC
comments.body_html:
I saw a comment on the “Deminvincibility” mod page from December 25, 2025, and didn’t bother investigating whether this issue existed there. I was curious to dig around and implement my own version. I mainly made this mod for myself, and I made it publicly available simply so others could use it if they wanted. You can see for yourself that it’s very simple, and I don’t claim any special credit.

If you believe this was copied from “Deminvincibility” mod, please use the “Report Mod” feature.

comments.body_html:
yeah, I saw that comment too. I could not reproduce their issues in testing with only Demi, so until they provide more evidence I will perceive that as user error and therefore not a problem with my mod specifically.

as for making this mod yourself, that’s absolutely fine. I am not pandering you for making something that is similar to another mod. I am just letting you know that “is simpler because it eliminates the additional features” is not exactly relevant as the additional features in my mod can be disabled, and are by default, which means there is no need to touch more than the top option.

it just seems like an odd point to bring up in comparison. you do what you wanna do, and have fun in the process. :) I appreciate there not being a monopoly here.
